<b>Barbed Bracelet</b> is a {{CrestSlot|Yellow|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It increases Needle damage by 25% but doubles most damage taken.<ref group="Note" name="calculation"/>

== Usefulness ==
Barbed Bracelet only increases the damage of the Needle itself, including the [[Needle Strike]]. [[Silk Skills]] are not affected.

As damage from nearly every source is doubled, it is not recommended to equip this Tool in areas with lots of environmental hazards, as the damage from missing a platforming section can quickly add up.
* Damage dealt by the cold on [[Mount Fay]] {{Damage|1|type=Ice}} is not doubled.

In many cases, it will reduce the amount of hits needed to kill an enemy by 1, making it effective when re-treading explored areas or farming for [[Rosaries]], as enemy attack patterns are already known and unexpected damage is less likely.

== How to Acquire ==
Found in [[Sinner's Road]], at the bottom of a pit at the easternmost end of the passage from [[Greymoor]].
